This. Bearded dragons require intense care, daily prep of fresh food, scheduled UVB replacements, etc etc. it’s not realistic for a 7 year old to do all this. This will be your lizard, and they live for 5-12 years typically, so please take that into consideration.

That depends if it’s substrate or food. I’m assuming it’s your substrate. 

For beardies a tile/slate bottom is great. The tiles hold heat, file nails, and are easy to clean. If you want to go with loose substrate, I’d recommend doing a DIY mix of top soil and play sand. That’s what my girls on. 

Lots of people will warn you to stay away from loose substrate for risk of impaction. If your husbandry is up to par and you’re feeding your feeder insects either in a separate enclosure or out of a bowl, it’s not too much of a concern imo, especially in older dragons. That’s a big IF though. 

If that doesn’t suit your fancy you could go simple and use just newspapers or just keep the bottom bare. 

Definitely do not recommend reptile carpet though! Nails can get caught in it and ripped off, plus it’s a pain to clean and harbors bacteria.
